decisions: Crypto historical trades and quotes extend the existing injected AsyncTransport, bounded concurrency, retry, cancellation, date-bound, and cursor-pagination behavior rather than creating a second provider client.

Configured crypto pairs are trimmed, uppercased, validated as BASE/QUOTE symbols, deduplicated, sent through the Alpaca /v1beta3/crypto/us/{trades|quotes} route, and returned in canonical slash-separated form.

NormalizedCryptoTrade and NormalizedCryptoQuote map directly to the T021 CRYPTO_TRADE_SCHEMA and CRYPTO_QUOTE_SCHEMA, retaining Decimal prices and fractional quantities and treating provider-optional identifiers, venues, and taker side as nullable.
Focused tests use an injected async transport and committed T026 BTC/USD and ETH/USD configuration; no provider request or credential is used.
limitations: Crypto UTC-day worker integration, storage/catalog publication, and rollout validation remain owned by later tasks.
No live Alpaca/provider calls, credentials, network access, or MyPy run was used.
The shared worktree contains unrelated concurrent changes; this task is limited to the files listed above.
No MyPy run was performed; repository tooling uses Ruff and ty.
